Approach the red pepper -> Pick/grasp the pepper -> Lift the pepper above the height of the block ->
Move to the tray -> Lower the pepper -> Release the pepper into the tray
retain_trajectory: approach block from above -> grasp block -> lift block -> move to empty safe area -> release block
